card.name: "or" before "as clinically indicated"
card.fires_on: The word "or" right after a monitoring or dosing schedule ("monthly thereafter," "twice per day,") where "as clinically indicated" or "as directed" follows. Also "as" in "as soon as possible" after a missed dose.

modes.label: Monitoring schedule then "or"
modes.description: "or" after a lab or test interval, leading into "as clinically indicated".
modes.example: Perform CBCs every 2 weeks for the first 2 months and then monthly thereafter,<< or>> as clinically indicated.

modes.label: Dosing instruction then "or"
modes.description: "or" after how often to apply a product, leading into "as directed by your physician".
modes.example: Apply Urea 40% to affected skin twice per day,<< or>> as directed by your physician.

modes.label: Missed dose wording
modes.description: "as" in "as soon as possible" after a missed dose.
modes.example: If a dose is missed, take the next dose<< as>> soon as possible with subsequent doses taken at
